breakdown.description: Inviscid simulation requested but top wall uses noSlip; inviscid wall should not impose no-slip viscous condition
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The specification explicitly requests an inviscid flow simulation (`Use rhoCentralFoam solver for inviscid flow simulation`) but then incorrectly applies a viscous boundary condition (`Apply noSlip velocity boundary condition at top wall`). The agent repeated the user's contradictory instructions instead of correcting the boundary condition to something appropriate for an inviscid wall, such as a slip condition.
